mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chatroom_info ( chatroom_name, chatroom_description, owner_seq, max_participant_num, use_yn, public_yn, room_pwd, reg_dt, mod_dt ) VALUES ( #{chatroomName}, #{chatroomDescription}, #{ownerSeq}, #{maxParticipantNum}, 'Y', #{publicYn}, #{roomPwd}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT c.chatroom_seq, c.chatroom_name, c.chatroom_description, c.owner_seq, u.nickname AS ownerNickname, c.max_participant_num, c.use_yn, c.public_yn, c.room_pwd, c.reg_dt, c.mod_dt FROM chatroom_info c LEFT OUTER JOIN user_info u ON c.owner_seq = u.user_seq WHERE c.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY reg_dt DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{page}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chatroom_info c LEFT OUTER JOIN user_info u ON c.owner_seq = u.user_seq WHERE c.use_yn = 'Y' LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{page}

SELECT c.chatroom_seq, c.chatroom_name, c.chatroom_description, c.owner_seq, c.max_participant_num, c.use_yn, c.public_yn, c.room_pwd, c.reg_dt, c.mod_dt FROM chatroom_info c WHERE c.chatroom_seq = #{chatroomSeq}
